result.summary: A residential street intersection with sidewalks but no marked pedestrian crossings or accessibility features like curb ramps. The wide, unmarked roadway and parked vehicles near the corners create potential visibility and safety issues for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, providing no designated space for pedestrians to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The absence of curb ramps makes the crossing inaccessible for users with mobility devices or strollers.
hazards.location_in_image: Corners of the foreground intersection

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corners block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian paths.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility by preventing parking at the intersection.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at all crossing points.

result.summary: This is a narrow residential street lined with row houses and parked cars on both sides. While sidewalks are present, there is a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossings, traffic control devices, or traffic calming measures visible in the immediate environment.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous rows of parked vehicles on both sides of the street block sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs throughout the street view

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Infrastructure
hazards.description: The absence of marked crosswalks or signage at the intersection increases the risk for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground intersection area

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Visible cracking and patching in the roadway surface can create tripping hazards or cause vehicles to swerve.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and foreground of the roadway

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style marked crosswalks at the intersection to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Implement curb extensions (bulb-outs) at the corners to shorten crossing distances and move pedestrians into the driver's line of sight.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps to physically enforce low speeds in this residential environment.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with continuous sidewalks but a complete lack of marked pedestrian crossing infrastructure. While a stop sign is present to regulate vehicle flow, the absence of curb ramps and the presence of parked cars near the corner create accessibility and visibility challenges for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalk
hazards.description: No painted markings exist to guide pedestrians or alert drivers to a crossing point at this intersection.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground roadway

hazards.name: Missing curb ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk ends in a vertical curb without a ramp, creating a significant barrier for people with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Bottom left corner of the sidewalk

hazards.name: Sight line obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner can obscure pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly delineate the pedestrian path and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: ADA-Compliant Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Construct sloped curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all crossing points to ensure universal accessibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting the Intersection
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the intersection to improve sight lines between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: This residential intersection lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure, including marked crosswalks and traffic control devices. The wide, unmarked asphalt roadway and potential sightline obstructions from corner vegetation create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at the intersection, leaving pedestrians without a designated or protected space to cross.

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
